description:
Relax, get comfortable, and enjoy finding objects, solving puzzles, and conquering mini-games on an exciting journey to various places imbued with warmth and comfort! 
Take a walk in nature, sit by the pool, and even barbecue in the backyard! 
Use your skills and knowledge to find all the hidden objects and complete the mini-games as you kick back and challenge yourself in this blissful hidden-object game!

- Customize your room by choosing decorative items and comfy furnishings!
- Solve puzzles, and look for hidden objects in every scene!
- Bring peaceful surroundings home with beautiful graphics and soothing music!
- Tons of challenging puzzles and mini-games!
name: Sweet Home: Look and Find 3 Collector's Edition
